title: A globally generated projective bundle is H-projective
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal E$ be a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module [pqf-def-coherent] generated by finitely many global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], and let $\pi:\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Proj}_S(\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal E)	o S$ be its projective-bundle morphism [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism], using the relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj] of the quasi-coherent symmetric algebra [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra]. Then $\pi$ is H-projective, i.e. projective in the finite-projective-space convention [def-kun-projective].
